pages.title: Tar and Bitumen
pages.text: Tar is a dark, sticky liquid. Moving through it is slow, but it supports water-like swimming and can extinguish fire. Default world generation can place tar lakes in the Overworld.

An isolated tar source can harden into Tar Ore when no neighboring face contains another tar source. Tar Ore, Tar, and Bitumen feed their supported processing and fuel recipes; they are different items.
